functions.name: contains
documentation: Returns true if any value in the table compares equal to the specified value.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table to search.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value for which to search.

returns.name: containsValue
documentation: True if any entry in the table has the specified value.

functions.name: count
documentation: Returns the number of entries in the table.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table whose entries will be counted.

returns.name: count
documentation: The number of entries in the table.

functions.name: create
documentation: Creates an empty table with storage preallocated for the specified number of array and non-array entries.

arguments.name: arraySizeHint
documentation: The number of array entries for which to preallocate storage.

arguments.name: nodeSizeHint
documentation: The number of non-array entries for which to preallocate storage.

functions.name: indexof
documentation: Returns the first integer index whose value compares equal to the specified value, searching consecutively from index 1 until the first nil value.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table to search.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value for which to search.

returns.name: index
documentation: The first matching index, or nil if no match is found.

functions.name: freeze
documentation: Marks a supplied table as frozen, preventing any modifications to its contents, or replacement of its metatable. If the table has a pre-existing metatable with a '__newindex' table or function, assignments will pass through without raising errors. For tainted code, only tables created by the same addon making this function call are permitted to be frozen.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table to freeze.

returns.name: frozen
documentation: The supplied table, passed through.

functions.name: keys
documentation: Returns an array containing the keys of the specified table.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table whose keys will be returned.

returns.name: keys
documentation: An array containing the table's keys. The order of the returned keys is unspecified.

functions.name: getcountinfo
documentation: Returns detailed information about the number and distribution of entries in the table.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table to inspect.

returns.name: numEntries
documentation: The total number of entries in the table.

returns.name: numPositiveIntegerKeys
documentation: The number of entries with positive integral keys.

returns.name: maxPositiveIntegerKey
documentation: The largest positive integral key in the table, or zero if no such keys were found.

functions.name: values
documentation: Returns an array containing the values of the specified table.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table whose values will be returned.

returns.name: values
documentation: An array containing the table's values. The order of the returned values is unspecified.

functions.name: isempty
documentation: Returns true if the table contains no entries.

returns.name: empty
documentation: True if the table contains no entries; otherwise false.

functions.name: isfrozen
documentation: Returns true if a table has been marked as frozen.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table to inspect.

returns.name: frozen
documentation: True if the table has been made read-only; otherwise false.

functions.name: removeunordered
documentation: Removes the value at the specified integer index by replacing it with the last value in the array and shortening the array by one element. The order of values in the array is not preserved.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table from which to remove a value.

arguments.name: index
documentation: The integer index of the value to remove. If omitted, the last value is removed.

returns.name: value
documentation: The removed value, or nil if the index is outside the array bounds.

functions.name: removevalue
documentation: Removes all values equal to the specified value from the array portion of a table.

arguments.name: table
documentation: The table from which to remove values.

arguments.name: value
documentation: The value to remove.

returns.name: removedCount
documentation: The number of values removed.
